purpose: Pre-registered joint source- and near-clone-isolated split for the expanded AMR cohort

rules.unit: drug x identity representative with an S/R label
rules.components: near-clone groups only (source components are reported, not isolated: the declared-source graph collapses to 43 components with the largest at 43%, so a balanced source-isolated split is infeasible and preserved as evidence in the source_isolated run)
rules.joint: one partition across drugs; each BioSample keeps the same partition in every task
rules.assignment: whole near-clone groups; seeded greedy by labeled-unit deficit; per drug >= min_groups groups and both classes in every partition
rules.conflicts: mixed-label clone groups flagged per drug; excluded from the primary analysis downstream
rules.source_reporting: source components may cross partitions; per-partition source composition and the largest source share must be reported, and source-independent test claims are not supported
